text: newUpdatePromise can preserve individual events or merge properties into one record. In merged mode it overwrites both newProps and oldProps for each later event; the result is not guaranteed to preserve the first old value for a repeatedly changed property. The current tag test expects two distinct transitions for a replacement tag set. Preserve individual assertions when intermediate states matter; no event sequence was executed.
